stable.notes: Recent messages are searchable — the newest turns were the one place you could not look. The search box also stays put while you scroll an archived day or a chat, instead of scrolling away with the content, so the term is still on screen when you reach the passage. And matches are marked in the text itself, yellow on dark and amber on light with dark ink either way: a tinted row said the term was somewhere in there, the mark says where. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
